scope: Compare placing one-Hz service on worker core1 with an explicit slice bound.
assumptions: Same cost model, moving the entire symbolic service budget from core0 to core1; actual timer IRQ/task split and PHY RF effects are not resolved.
40000-cycle slice admission bound is a declared sensitivity setting, not a measured guarantee; applied to both cores by existing model.
Five phases at 4000 banks; only all-passing configurations extended to 20000 banks at half-period phase.
